purpose: 2026-10-22 review: replace oblique objects with frontal views
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW replacement production game object sheet hq_jaemtri_objects.png, exactly 1536x1024 landscape, true transparent RGBA background.
2D side-scrolling beat-em-up game art for a present-day South Korean agency office. Clean FLAT cel shading in only 2-3 tone steps, crisp hard edges, bold dark outlines about 6-8px, few LARGE simple shapes readable after shrinking. NOT pixel art. Muted desaturated grey-green, charcoal, beige, brown, with restrained blue monitor screens. No painterly texture, noise, fine scratches, gradients, bloom, blur, text, letters, numbers, logos, people, floor or ground shadows.
Arrange EXACTLY NINE separate objects in an EVEN 3x3 grid (three columns each 512px wide, three rows about 341px high). Entire object inside its own cell with at least 24px empty transparent margin on all sides. No drawn grid, labels or cell backgrounds. Each object fills most of its cell, independent scales.
CRITICAL CAMERA CORRECTION: ALL nine objects viewed SQUARELY FROM THE FRONT, front face parallel to image, ZERO yaw, no left or right rotation, no three-quarter perspective, no visible left/right side panels of boxes/fridge/printer/bookcase. Vertical edges vertical, front horizontal edges horizontal. Slightly elevated orthographic camera exposes ONLY a thin horizontal strip of top surfaces, not a broad tabletop. The same camera applies to every object.
Row-major objects:
1 top-left: L-shaped office desk with exactly TWO blue-screen monitors and ONE keyboard. Desk's long front edge horizontal, screens flat facing viewer, left return extends straight toward viewer WITHOUT rotating the desk. Indicate L return with a slightly projecting rectangular left pedestal and shallow top strip; NO diagonal receding desk wings. No clutter.
2 top-middle: gaming chair, perfectly centered frontal symmetrical seat and back, muted charcoal and desaturated red edging.
3 top-right: printer on a simple stand, both printer front and stand square frontal rectangles. Lid and paper drawers closed.
4 middle-left: stack of 3 closed cardboard boxes, each front a flat rectangle with a central tape strip, no visible side faces, only narrow top strips.
5 middle-middle: mini fridge, closed, perfectly front-facing door, handle and 3 simple picture-only stickers with NO writing. No visible side panel.
6 middle-right: desk lamp with base and bent support, its lamp shade opening facing viewer, restrained cream light inside shade and no light spill on transparent area.
7 bottom-left: trash bin full of 4-5 large simplified crumpled papers.
8 bottom-middle: floor fan, round centered front-facing head, few clear blades, sparse simplified grille, stand and broad base.
9 bottom-right: tall bookshelf with 3 shelves of a FEW large binders, blank spines, closed rectangular outer shape perfectly facing viewer, no visible side panel.
Do not copy the earlier rejected image's oblique angle, detailed rendering or dark backdrop. This is a freshly drawn flat-shaded sheet with real transparency.
